## User-visible change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link related issues where useful.

## Validation

Describe the checks performed and any migration or documentation changes.

## Attribution

Preserve commit authorship, including for small fixes. For jointly authored changes, agree on co-author credit with the contributors. Mention testing, reports, or documentation help you would like acknowledged, using each person's preferred public name or handle.

Confirm that shared examples and logs use synthetic or redacted data and that new files have appropriate SPDX notices.
